title: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer via Cadet Pathway (NSW)
content_text: Daracon Cadet Pathway: join as casual civil labourer from first year, apply for Cadet in third year, eligible to apply for Graduate role in final year. GradConnection lists no active graduate opportunities. Vacancy pages publish careers@daracon.com.au for direct applications. Daracon is a NSW civil construction group delivering subdivision, road, rail and infrastructure works from Beresfield, Auburn, Hunter Valley and Gunnedah.
apply_instructions: Email careers@daracon.com.au (published on Daracon vacancy pages: Click Apply Now or email your application directly to careers@daracon.com.au).
